text:
incident-bot: Pager -> HIGH error rate and sustained 5xx spike for org "HorizonRetail" (org_id: org-9412). Metrics: 5xx ratio ~20% over 3m, total QPS ~4x baseline. Paging on-call @Amelia.
Amelia: Ack. Pulling dashboards and logs — standing by. ETA 2m.
Amelia: Seeing repeated token-generation throttles into rl-svc; token buckets exhausted on their org key. Latency doubled, queue depth rising.
Raj: I'm joining. Can we do a temporary org-level rate bump + feature throttle? This looks like a single org flood.
Amelia: Agreed. Plan: 1) temporary RL increase for org-9412, 2) disable long-context embeddings for that org to reduce KV/cache pressure, 3) notify CS/Sales. Executing step 1 now.
Amelia: /ops rl adjust --org org-9412 --rate 300qps --burst 600 --duration 30m  # temp bump
deploy-bot: rl adjust job 68321 accepted by controller, started by Amelia.
Tim: I'll flip the feature flag for long-context embeddings for org-9412. Patching on config service now.
Tim: /config toggle feature_long_context_embeddings org-9412 off  # done, propagated to edge in ~15s
Lina: FYI this is a key customer campaign window. @Omar can you reach out to their SE?
Omar: Just pinged SE and account owner. They confirmed a marketing spike and asked us to prioritize throughput. I've opened a case and put a note in the customer thread.
Raj: After RL bump + feature toggle, 5xx rate dropped from 20% -> ~6% in last 2m; p50 latency reduced ~25%. Queue depth trending down.
Amelia: Good. Keep monitoring. I'm setting an automatic revert at +30m unless we extend. Adding a manual emergency rollback command in case we need to cut:
Amelia: /ops rl adjust --org org-9412 --rate 120qps --burst 200 --duration 0m  # revert to baseline
Tim: Also gated heavy-model routing for that org to fallback model to cheaper smaller variant to reduce GPU pressure.
Tim: /route set org-9412 model_fallback=compact-1.1 immediate
Lina: I've informed sales and escalations. They want a short customer update once metrics are stable.
Omar: Customer acknowledged and asked for postmortem; I volunteered to draft the timeline and customer-facing summary.
Amelia: Handing off monitoring to Michael (night on-call) in 10m. Leaving notes in the incident runbook and the RL job id (68321). If anything regresses, page paging policy and escalate to eng-sre.
Michael: Acked, I'll watch the dashboards and the revert timer.
Amelia: Last check: error rate now ~3.5%, latency improving. If stable at 1766504650 we'll let the auto-revert run and then schedule a follow-up to decide permanent quotas/ratelimit changes.
Michael: Understood. Will update if we see any uptick.
Amelia: Thanks all — closing active mitigation steps in thread. Follow-up: postmortem + action items (RL policy review, customer quota conversation, autoscale tuning).
